priya: heads-up: onboarding qx2b-int4 shows a spike in label disagreement for longform + code prompts. sampler also surfaced many near-duplicates due to fencing/markdown.
tom: saw that. tokenizer differences create distinct fingerprints. can we canonicalize before hashing?
zack: quick plan: canonicalize (strip fences, normalize whitespace, drop trailing punctuation), rehash paused batches, cluster >0.9 sim, push clusters to rapid-review.
emily: i'll build the 800-sample micro-eval (long/short/code/markdown) excluding clustered near-duplicates. will run baseline vs int4 and generate disagreement matrix.
labeler-bot: automated: batch 4123 paused (duplicate surge).
priya: tom, push sampler flag FUZZY_SIM=0.91 to staging. zack, run clustering script: `tools/cluster_hashes.py --batch 4123 --sim 0.9`.
tom: deployed flag to staging, monitoring. will promote if false-positive rate <2%.
zack: ran cluster job: 378 -> 62 clusters, 298 collapsed. pushed exemplar set to label-ops.
emily: micro-eval running now; will share heatmap and top 40 high-disagreement prompts to #golden-review. if longform disagreement >5%, we expand golden and seed microgoldens from exemplars.
priya: nice. notif me when results in, i'll coordinate labeler rota for the rapid-review window. :sparkles:
